<DOCSTRING>
Initializes a new User object with the specified name and age.

This class represents a user in the system, storing their name and age. It provides a method to check if the user is an adult.

@attribute name (String): The name of the user, must not be null or empty.
@attribute age (int): The age of the user, must be a non-negative integer.
</DOCSTRING>
